personality_one_liner: A structured, highly scannable, and trust-inspiring mobile interface driven by clear hierarchy, navy professionalism, and teal actionability.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous vertical rhythm for scannability. Minimum 56pt tappable height. Ensure sticky CTAs do not cover content.

do's: Use for bottom tab bars when content scrolls behind.
Use for sticky 'Apply Now' bottom containers on Job Details.
Use for pinned filter chips rows in Job Listings.
Overlay hero cards with blurred brandTertiary for depth.
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields.
Do not use on regular list rows or data tables.

screens.name: Landing / Hero
screens.purpose: First entry point introducing the platform with search and featured jobs.

states.error: Error fetching featured jobs + Retry button

screens.layout: Hero image with top-down gradient scrim. A prominent search bar floating below the safe area. Two horizontal scrollable sections: Job Categories (chips) and Featured Jobs (cards). CTA sticky at the bottom for unauthenticated users.

screens.name: Login / Register

states.error: Inline text under inputs for invalid credentials

screens.layout: Segmented control at the top to toggle Seeker/Employer. Clean, single-column input form. Large primary CTA button. Social login options separated by 'OR' divider.

screens.name: Job Seeker Dashboard
screens.purpose: Home for seekers showing active applications, saved jobs, and recommended roles.

states.empty: Illustration + 'Start exploring jobs to see recommendations'

screens.layout: Greeting header. 'Applications Status' quick-stat cards (Applied, Interviewing). Vertical list of 'Jobs For You'. Glass bottom tab bar (Home, Search, Apps, Profile).

screens.name: Employer Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for employers to manage jobs and candidates.

states.empty: Illustration + 'Post your first job to start receiving applications'

screens.layout: Real-time stats row (Active Jobs, Total Applicants). 'Action Needed' horizontal scroll (e.g., Unread Applications). Recent candidates presented in compact cards instead of tables. Floating Action Button (FAB) to Post Job.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Platform oversight, statistics, and pending approvals.
screens.layout: Grid of KPIs (Total Users, Live Jobs). Section for 'Pending Employer Approvals' as actionable list rows. Navigation mapped via a drawer or tab bar.

screens.name: Job Listing
screens.purpose: Search results with advanced filtering and pagination.

states.empty: No jobs found for criteria + 'Clear Filters' CTA

screens.layout: Sticky search header with horizontally scrolling filter chips (Location, Type, Salary). Vertical list of job cards. Each card shows Logo, Title, Company, Location, Salary, and a Save icon.

screens.name: Job Details
screens.purpose: Full job description and application initiation.
screens.layout: Top section: Company Logo + Title + Badges (Type, Level). Scrollable body: Description, Requirements, Benefits. Sticky bottom container (glassmorphism) with primary 'Apply Now' CTA and Secondary 'Save' button.

screens.name: Post Job Form
screens.purpose: Employer form to create or edit a job listing.
screens.layout: Single-column scrollable form. Labels above inputs. Grouped sections (Details, Requirements, Salary). Sticky primary CTA 'Publish Job' over a keyboard-avoiding view.

screens.name: Application Management
screens.purpose: Employer view of candidates applied to a specific job.
screens.layout: Segmented control or horizontal chips acting as Kanban stages (New, Review, Shortlisted, Hired). Candidate cards showing Avatar, Name, Experience, and bottom action row (Move Stage, Reject).

screens.name: Application Tracking

states.empty: Illustration + 'You haven't applied to any jobs yet'

screens.layout: List of applied jobs. Each card includes a vertical timeline or clear color-coded status badge (e.g., Teal for Interviewing, Red for Rejected, Navy for Applied).

screens.name: Profile Settings
screens.purpose: Manage user details, resumes, logos, and preferences.
screens.layout: Avatar/Logo upload section at the top. Form fields for details. Dedicated section for Resume PDF upload (Seeker). Save changes button at the bottom.

screens.name: Saved Jobs
screens.layout: Vertical list of job cards. Swipe-to-delete or explicit 'Remove' icon on each card.

screens.name: Notifications
screens.purpose: Alerts for application updates, new jobs, and messages.
screens.layout: Simple vertical list grouped by date (Today, Yesterday). Unread items highlighted with a subtle `brandTertiary` background.

screens.name: Contact & About
screens.layout: Accordion-style FAQs. Simple contact form. Links to terms and privacy policies.

hero_background.alt: Modern corporate office building glass facade

employer_onboarding.alt: Professional working on laptop in modern office

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for typography. It provides the clean, legible structure required for professional environments.

Color Palette: Strictly implement the provided Navy Blue (`#1E3A8A`), Teal (`#0D9488`), and White (`#FFFFFF`) palette per user requirements. Ensure Teal is used for actionable items (buttons, active states) and Navy for strong structural elements.

Dashboard Layouts: Utilize card-based single-column layouts for maximum scannability on mobile. Ensure CTAs like 'Apply Now' are sticky at the bottom over scrolling content, wrapped in a glassmorphism container.

Application Tracking: Implement visually distinct status badges for the 5 application states (Applied, Under Review, Shortlisted, Rejected, Hired). Use color coding (e.g., Teal for Hired/Shortlisted, Red for Rejected, Navy for Applied).
Candidate Management: For Employer screens, use compact cards to display candidates instead of dense data tables, enabling easy swipe/thumb actions.
Imagery: Always apply a top-down gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) when placing text over the hero image. Use the provided company logo imagery as rich header covers for job listings.
Role Navigation: Ensure the App implements distinct bottom tab navigation based on the authenticated user's role (Seeker vs Employer). Admin panel may utilize a drawer if tabs get too crowded.
